flagged.title: Incarnation, Crucifixion & Resurrection
flagged.reason: The video misquotes the Nicene Creed as stating Jesus sits 'at the right hand of God' rather than 'at the right hand of the Father', which would lead to lost marks on creed quotation questions.

mark_affecting.quote: As the Nicene Creed states, he sits at the right hand of God.
